context: A retired exec advises on company succession
purpose: Teach: 久保/浩/茂/竹内/後藤/従い/プロトコル/函

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 久保くん、退任時の心得、若い頃に伝えたな。
lines.en: Kubo — I told you the principles of stepping down when you were younger.
lines.style: Slow, measured opening. Deep breath before the name. Quiet certainty—the weight of decades distilled into a few words. Thoughtful pause after the comma, as if watching the memory settle.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。次代は浩さん、茂さんが牽引してくれます。
lines.en: Yes. Hiroshi-san and Shigeru-san will lead us forward.
lines.style: Respectful but steady. No hesitation in the affirmation. Slight lift on the second names—confidence in the people he's naming, not doubt. Eye contact held firm.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 竹内くんも、後藤くんも、慎重に育てろ。
lines.en: You must nurture Takeuchi and Goto with the same care.
lines.style: Firmer now. Light emphasis on 'must'—not a suggestion but a responsibility. Lean forward slightly. Each name given equal weight, deliberate. No rush.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。新プロトコルにも、教えに従い対応します。
lines.en: Yes. I'll follow your guidance in handling the new protocol.
lines.style: Quick, respectful acknowledgment. No elaboration—he understands the mandate. Slight nod implied in the cadence. Humble but not deferential; a capable person taking on a charge.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 函館支店、若い頃の私の心の故郷だ。
lines.en: The Hakodate branch — it was the heart of who I was when I was young.
lines.style: Voice softens on 'Hakodate.' Longer pause before the second clause. Wistful, gazing inward. Slow trailing finish, like watching something precious recede. Breath underneath the words.
